newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche under pressure in pre-bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: Roche under pressure in pre-bourse trade.

text.p: Roche Holding AG securities came under pressure in early pre-bourse trading after banks both in Switzerland and abroad changed their recommendations to a "hold" from "buy", traders said.
Roche participation certificates were down some 265 francs, or 2.2 percent, to 11,455/520 francs before the official start of bourse trading.

Roche this week reported that its sales in the 1997 first quarter rose by 18 percent in Swiss francs and by three percent on a local currency basis. Pharmaceutical division sales were up by 19 percent in Swiss francs and by three percent in local currencies.

Traders said news from competitor Novartis AG on Thursday that its sales were up 22 percent in Swiss francs and eight percent in local currencies had led to some investor shift out of Roche and into Novartis.
Novartis shares were unchanged at 1,832/838 Swiss francs following a three percent gain on Thursday. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
